title: Day 13x — What a MEMS Accelerometer Is

slides.title: Where we are
items: Yesterday we wired the LSM303AGR onto the I2C bus, read 0x33 out of its WHO_AM_I register, and watched the transactions on the logic analyzer.

Today we'll look at how the sensor works inside: the physics that senses acceleration, the different configurations in its datasheet, and the format in which the acceleration data is sent from the accelerometer to us.
slides.presenterNote: 50 minutes today: 2 settling + 1 announcements, then Parts of 11 / 2 / 9 / 20 / 3, and a 2-minute close. Kits stay in bags — nothing is wired today; the load is all conceptual, and Part 4 is the crucial step. No checkpoint minutes exist; if a Part runs long, the levers are Part 2 down to one example (−1), the close absorbing one minute, and the Part 3 commit's discussion minute. Spend them the moment Part 1 or Part 3 runs long, not at the end — all three land before Part 4, and Parts 4 and 5 are not cuttable.
